title: With a sharp outflow of capital ahead of Tet 2026, the Vietnamese stock market is plunged into the red.
snippet: Downward pressure intensified as foreign investors resumed strong net selling. The total net selling value on the HoSE reached over 1,025 billion VND. Notably, VCB saw net selling of 610.74 billion VND, followed by VIC with 340.30 billion VND.

title: Stock market in 2026 - A pivotal moment for foreign capital to reverse and become net buyers.
snippet: Despite existing short-term pressures, BSC believes that the medium- to long-term outlook for attracting foreign capital is supported by the market upgrade roadmap in September 2026, a new wave of IPOs, and expectations that the US Federal Reserve (Fed) will continue to lower interest rates, helping to reduce exchange rate pressure and maintain a low USD level. Sharing the same view, experts from Tien Phong Securities Joint Stock Company (TPS) also believe that the net selling trend by foreign investors may continue in the short term.
